explanation: Only D1 is ever above zero: at D1 it is high when the previous trial ended in state S2, and 0 when it ended in S1, whatever the reward was. It is about 10 if that S2 was a rare transition (the agent chose a1) and about 6-9 if it was common (the agent chose a2), with about 6 in the first ~15 trials and 7-9 later; GO and D2 are always 0.
